questions.question: Use calculate_correlation in order to know What is the relationship between sleep duration and screen time based on the scatter plot visualization?

answer.value: The scatter plot reveals a very weak negative correlation (approximately -0.02) between sleep duration and screen time, suggesting that increased screen time has minimal impact on sleep duration in this dataset. The data points are widely scattered with no clear linear pattern. Interestingly, the color-coded diet quality shows that individuals with poor diet quality actually have slightly higher average sleep duration (7.09 hours) compared to those with good (7.07 hours) or average (7.06 hours) diet quality, indicating that diet quality may not be a strong predictor of sleep duration either.

key_insights: Very weak negative correlation of -0.02 between sleep and screen time
No clear linear pattern in the scatter plot
Diet quality shows minimal impact on sleep duration
Poor diet group has slightly higher sleep duration than good diet group
